channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: What Could Elias Pettersson's Olympic Showing Mean For His Canucks Future?
item.description: Will a strong Olympic showing boost Elias Pettersson's trade value or secure his long-term future with the Vancouver Canucks?

item.title: 'We Want As Soon As Possible Belarus And Russia Back,' Says IIHF President Luc Tardif
item.description: The IIHF president wants Russia and Belarus back in international competition, mainly because it would mean the war has ended if they do return. What does the NHL think about Russia's participation in the World Cup of Hockey?

item.title: Olympics: Tragically Hip Song Plays After Canada's First Goal In Men's Hockey
item.description: "Blow at High Dough" played as Macklin Celebrini opened the scoring for Canada's Olympic men's hockey team, but "Feeling Good" by The Sheepdogs played for the following goals.

item.title: Olympic Women's Hockey Power Rankings: USA Lead As Quarterfinals Are Set
item.description: Team USA has looked unstoppable in women's hockey at the Olympics. They lead Canada, Finland and the rest of the 10 squads in these power rankings.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Wallstedt And Tippett Resurface In Trade Buzz, Kings Could Shop Foegele
item.description: The Minnesota Wild and Philadelphia Flyers must decide if they'll use Jesper Wallstedt and Owen Tippett as trade chips, while a surplus of forwards could force the Los Angeles Kings to move Warren Foegele.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Canada Rough Up Czechs In More Ways Than One
item.description: Team Canada not only had scoring from all over the lineup and tons of skill, but their physicality was on display. Connor McDavid's hit may have topped them all.

item.title: Would The Maple Leafs Pursuing Darren Raddysh Haunt Them Like A Former UFA Signing?
item.description: One analyst suggested the Toronto Maple Leafs should pursue Tampa Bay Lightning defenseman Darren Raddysh in free agency. Others aren't so sure. Here's why signing him this summer seems too risky at this point.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show At The Games: Reacting To Canada Beating Czechia In Men's Olympic Hockey
item.description: Michael Traikos, Andrew McInnis and Michael Augello discuss line combinations, standout players and other impressions from the Canada and Czechia game in Olympic men's hockey.

item.title: Report: Disqualified Ukrainian Olympian Included Killed Hockey Goalie On Helmet
item.description: Ukrainian skeleton slider Vladyslav Heraskevych included hockey goaltender Oleksiy Loginov on his helmet featuring athletes and coaches killed since Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, according to a report.

item.title: The NHL Should Handle Goalie Interference Like The IIHF Did In USA And Latvia Game
item.description: Brock Nelson and the Americans did well to bounce back from a goalie interference call on some pretty soft contact that disallowed one of their goals. But the IIHF's black-and-white rule is better than the NHL's interpretation of goalie interference.
